name: Olympic Dam northeast east process basin
scope: Whole independently placed northeast paired process basin at Olympic Dam, preserving all nineteen original numerical outer controls. Complete foundation, exterior shell, inner liner, thick rim, recessed dark process surface and estimated central maintenance bridge. Other mine vessels, buildings, conveyors and shafts remain separate.

references.caption: View of Earth taken during ISS Expedition 38.
references.artist: Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center

review.method: Previously cleared published NASA original and full native numerical roof outline
review.notes: Already-cleared published Qualla NASA ISS038-E-29810 original shows the two paired reddish-brown circular process surfaces northeast of the central group. A bounded visual numerical-plan comparison supports this broad basin morphology; this is not surveyed photo registration or verified individual process identity. Model uses the original numerical outline and an estimated low open vessel section. Specific height, shell material, surface level, hub, maintenance bridge, access details, exact process function and2014-to2026 continuity remain unmeasured. No photo texture, report graphics or other imagery.
